name: @kya-brasil/mcp

tools.name: kya_verify
tools.description: Free. Who answers for this AI agent? Looks up the agent's KYA Brasil credential at the issuer and returns the principal (a Brazilian company with CNPJ and name, or a person verified by e-CPF with nothing personal), the mandate, the live status (active, suspended, revoked, expired) and its history. Give credential_id, or the agent key to find its active credentials. Use it before trusting an order, payment or signature that comes from an agent.

credential_id.description: The agent's credential_id (the agent sends it with its request, e.g. in the KYA-Credential header).

agent.description: Alternative to credential_id: the agent's key.

kind.description: evm: Ethereum-style wallet; web-bot-auth: Ed25519 key; erc8004: on-chain agent.

id.description: 0x address, base64url Ed25519 public key, or eip155:<chainId>:<registry>:<agentId>.

tools.name: kya_revocations
tools.description: Free. Credentials the issuer revoked since a date (default: the last 30 days). For verifiers that cache credentials and want to drop revoked ones.

tools.name: kya_sign_link
tools.description: Free. The link to send to whoever holds the e-CNPJ or e-CPF (owner, accountant, the person) so they see what is being authorized and sign in the browser. Use after a registration: give credential_id and challenge_id, and the agent's signature of the challenge so the holder only signs with the certificate.

credential_id.description: The agent's credential_id (the agent sends it with its request, e.g. in the KYA-Credential header).

challenge_id.description: challenge.id from the registration or renewal.

agent_signature.description: The agent key's signature of challenge.text.

tools.name: kya_check_action
tools.description: $0.01 (x402, USDC on Base; set KYA_PRIVATE_KEY). May this agent perform this action under its mandate, and is its credential active right now? The issuer answers with a signed verdict that lists every rule it evaluated, usable as evidence in a dispute. For a free, unsigned answer use kya_check_mandate on the mandate from kya_verify.

credential_id.description: The agent's credential_id (the agent sends it with its request, e.g. in the KYA-Credential header).

action.description: What the agent wants to do, lowercase (order, pay, quote, sign, ...).

counterparty.description: Your CNPJ, domain or wallet address (the other side of the operation).

spent_today.description: What this agent already spent today, if you track it; needed for max_per_day (the issuer keeps no record of acts).

payment_network.description: Payment network of this operation: visa, mastercard, elo, pix, ...

payment_ref_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the payment token reference or PAR used, never a card number.

tools.name: kya_verify_paid
tools.description: $0.01 (x402, USDC on Base; set KYA_PRIVATE_KEY). Same answer as kya_verify, without the free daily limit, plus a signed receipt of the verification.

credential_id.description: The agent's credential_id (the agent sends it with its request, e.g. in the KYA-Credential header).

tools.name: kya_check_mandate
tools.description: Free and offline. Evaluates an intended action against a KYA mandate (the credential's mandate from kya_verify, or one you are drafting) and lists every rule with its result: action, ceilings per operation and per day, currency, counterparty (with *.domain wildcards), payment instrument, validity window. Nothing is sent anywhere.

mandate.description: A KYA mandate: actions, max_per_operation, max_per_day, currencies, counterparties, payment_instruments, valid_from, valid_until, delegation.

action.description: What the agent wants to do, lowercase (order, pay, quote, sign, ...).

counterparty.description: Your CNPJ, domain or wallet address (the other side of the operation).

spent_today.description: What this agent already spent today, if you track it; needed for max_per_day (the issuer keeps no record of acts).

payment_network.description: Payment network of this operation: visa, mastercard, elo, pix, ...

payment_ref_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the payment token reference or PAR used, never a card number.

tools.name: kya_validate_mandate
tools.description: Free and offline. Checks a mandate against the KYA schema before registering an agent with it, and returns it normalized (actions deduplicated, counterparties and payment instruments normalized). Refuses card numbers and malformed fields with the reason.

mandate.description: A KYA mandate: actions, max_per_operation, max_per_day, currencies, counterparties, payment_instruments, valid_from, valid_until, delegation.

tools.name: kya_verify_credential_offline
tools.description: Free. Checks a credential document you already hold: the issuer's Ed25519 signature (key from the issuer's /.well-known/kya.json, fetched once) and the expiry. It cannot see a revocation made after issuance (live_status is unknown); use kya_verify for the live status.

credential.description: The full credential JSON, including its attestation.

tools.name: kya_verify_delegation
tools.description: Free and offline. A sub-agent acts under a delegation chain signed by the credential's agent (KYA-Delegation header). Checks every link (signatures, depth, lifetime, each mandate contained in the one above) against the credential, returns the key that must sign the sub-agent's requests, and, when an action is given, evaluates it on every level: allowed only if all of them allow it.

credential.description: The credential (credential_id, agent, mandate, expires_at), e.g. the `credential` from kya_verify.

chain.description: The KYA-Delegation header value (base64url), or the chain as a JSON array.

tools.name: kya_about
tools.description: Free and offline. What KYA Brasil is, how an agent gets a credential, which tools to use as a verifier, and where the specification and the issuer's keys are.
